Extensive Permit Requirements: NJ municipalities have strict permit requirements for most work NJ requires permits for nearly everything—even fence replacement in some towns. Reddit users report that permit fees are high but unpermitted work creates major issues at sale. CO (certificate of occupancy) is required to close.

Shore Property Flood Zones: Jersey Shore properties face strict FEMA flood zone requirements Post-Sandy regulations are strict. Many shore homes must be elevated if substantially improved. Reddit users recommend checking flood zone status and insurance requirements before any major work.

High Labor & Material Costs: NJ has some of the highest construction costs in the US Labor costs are 30-50% above national average. Reddit warns that lowball bids usually mean unlicensed workers or shortcuts. Get multiple bids but be suspicious of prices far below others.

Radon Testing: Northern NJ has significant radon levels NJ DEP recommends testing all homes. Radon is particularly high in Hunterdon, Somerset, and Morris counties. Reddit users recommend testing before basement finishing.
